name: Ipolytölgyes (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ipolytölgyes (a green and blue shield with a cross, an oak bough, a wavy stripe and ears of grain) below the name IPOLYTÖLGYES in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
